decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress probe is a publicly celebrated flagship of Jansen's geothermal line, so its high visibility and investment make continuation almost certain.
The single-U probe is a core element of the established geothermal probe range that the firm has committed to, and the missing website data is no evidence of failure.
This multi-model surface technology line supports the geothermal portfolio and reflects substantial development investment, so dropping it would contradict the firm's innovation direction.
Fire-protection steel profiles are close to the established building-systems business and serve regulated demand, so the firm will keep them.
The slim profile system extends the firm's core steel profile offering, and with sunk tooling costs and public positioning it is likely to stay in the range.

The decorative surface system is more peripheral, but it builds on the established profile business and its disappointing visibility can still be attributed to temporary market conditions, so the firm keeps it.
